bio.text: Adam Gray represents California's 13th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, which includes Merced County and portions of Madera, Stanislaus, San Joaquin and Fresno Counties.
Before Congress he spent 10 years in the California State Assembly representing Merced and Stanislaus Counties.
He was born and raised in Merced, where he lives, and is an educator at UC Merced.
